component.name: JW Calendar
component.summary: Browse calendars, inspect dates, and calculate date differences

description.p: JW Calendar is a desktop calendar reference for exploring civil dates without an internet connection.
Browse Gregorian and Julian month and year layouts, inspect weekday, ordinal day, ISO week and Julian Day Number, convert between the two calendar systems, and calculate elapsed days between dates.
Export a month as a print-ready HTML page or a CSV file. The application does not require an account or network access.
United States federal statutory and observed holidays are also available from the command line. This listing does not include state, local, or one-off closures.
